caption: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and vibrant green scallions. Served in a white bowl with a red spoon, it rests on a vibrant red surface under bright, even lighting.

segments_info.text: The table is a smooth, vibrant red surface with subtle light reflections and faint texture variations.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with a slightly glistening surface and irregular, soft edges.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and steaming, with thin noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
White ceramic ramen bowl with red logo, smooth surface, slightly raised rim, and subtle speckled texture.
A glossy, reddish-brown spoon with a smooth, curved surface and slightly worn handle edge.
